properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Raised by proj:chama, 2026-09-02, and it is the half of their gap_to_prompt report that root-cause did NOT dissolve.

THEIR CASE: they mangled a GapCandidate between the two passes, the question degraded to raw detector jargon, and THAT degraded wording is what got recorded as the question asked. `open_questions` still shows their duplicated title as the `context_setter`. The good phrasing existed only in the chat with the user. They found no way to correct it — `withdraw_question` retires a question overtaken by events, which is a different fact. In their words: "a transcription slip is now indelible design record."

⭐ THE MECHANICAL CAUSE IS SEPARATELY FIXABLE AND DOES NOT ANSWER THIS. `fact:the-gap-replay-warning-exists-because-rehydrate-declines-to-run-when-the-caller-sent-text` shows the re-key was preventable — the server already resolves the gap by id and declined to. Fix that and this particular slip stops happening. THE QUESTION SURVIVES ANYWAY, because a question can be badly worded without any transcription error at all: an agent can simply phrase it poorly, and the record is equally permanent.

THE OPTIONS, in the user's terms rather than the schema's:

· **Leave it immutable.** A Question records WHAT WAS ASKED. Editing it after the fact makes the record a claim about what someone wishes they had asked, and the answer stored against it was given to the original words. This is a real anti-forgery argument and it is the same family as `dec:certainty-derived` and the OBSOLETES doctrine (a thing withdrawn keeps its status; the edge carries the new fact).
· **Allow re-derivation, not editing.** Regenerate the wording from the live gap, keeping the old text on the record as superseded. Preserves the audit trail and fixes the common case, which is a mechanical degradation rather than a change of mind.
· **Allow an amendment edge.** Leave the Question untouched and let a later record say "this was asked badly; here is what was meant" — the same shape as recording a ChangeEvent before deleting a stale edge, which is the move the delete_edge description talked chama INTO and which they praised.
· **Do nothing and say so.** Document the immutability as intended, so the next agent does not spend the session looking for a tool that is deliberately absent.

⚠️ WHAT MAKES THIS GENUINELY UNDECIDED: a Question is one of the few nodes whose content is MACHINE-DERIVED from another node's text rather than authored. So "what was asked" and "what the gap said" are two different facts that currently share one field, and none of the four options is obviously right without knowing which of them the record is for.

NOTHING HERE IS PROPOSED. `answer_question` reaching only ids it can derive is a related but distinct defect already recorded (`fact:defect-a-question-not-created-by-gap-to-prompt-can-never-be-answered`).
properties.name: OPEN — a Question's recorded wording is indelible. Is that a deliberate anti-forgery property, or an unintended one nobody chose?
properties.rationale:
Recorded as an idea because chama asked for a specific mechanism ("some way to re-derive or amend a Question's text") and the mechanism is the least interesting part — the question underneath is what a Question node is FOR, and that has never been stated. Answering the mechanism without answering that would produce a tool whose correct use nobody could describe.

Not promoted to a requirement: nobody has been asked, and immutability may well be the right answer.
